detail.longDescription: Hey HN! I am Ashish from AutoCua (automatic computer use agent). I am building super computer use agent. Imagine a computer use that is not limited to computer automation. ALL OF THAT WHILE IT'S DOING COMPUTER USE. Completely open source written in Python + Rust, Under MIT License. Do check out Repo- https://github.com/ComputerUseAgent/AutoCua Watch demo of AutoCUA Playing CLASH OF CLAN + CLASH ROYALE on PHONE wirelessly + CHESS while controlling browser too. Video is attached on README.md. Have a look tell me what you'd throw next at it. i'll be there in the thread all day. Thanks!!:)
